title: Continental European stream invertebrate richness stopped rising after about 2012, but a shift to pollution-sensitive cold-water families continued and offset the warming signal (TREAM 1995-2019)
abstract: We tested whether the reported halt of European freshwater invertebrate recovery after about 2010 also stopped the composition change along a pollution axis, and whether this change hides a response to warming. We used the public TREAM data (26,668 site-year samples, 1,816 sites, 22 countries; main test 1,375 continental non-UK sites, 1990-2019). Each sample was scored with an external English family ammonia tolerance (no TREAM data) and with a family thermal index learned in other countries. Models compared each site with itself and removed sampling month; intervals are two-way (site and year) clustered or site bootstrap. Continental family richness rose by 0.27 families per year until a break in 2012 (2009-2015) and then levelled (+0.06 per year, -0.15 to +0.15). The community ammonia index kept decreasing toward sensitive families: -0.0014 per year in 1995-2009 and -0.0009 per year in 2010-2019 (-0.0014 to -0.0004). The 2010-2019 decrease was outside a tau-shuffle null (p = 0.005) and robust to removal of any family, Denmark, rare families, effort and a fixed-site panel. It repeated in France, Spain and Denmark, not in Nordic sites, and reversed in Hungary. Sensitive families are cold-water families (family r = 0.36). The pollution part of the community thermal index fell by 0.0040 C per year in 1995-2019, which is 1.4-1.6 times the rise expected from full tracking of local warming with the within-country spatial slope; the total index did not change. The remainder rose by about the expected amount, but random family thermal scores gave remainders of the same size, so a thermal response is not established. UK sites (overlapping an earlier English study) showed a weaker late composition shift. Limits: the pollution score is English and contains co-varying stressors; family-level thermal scores are coarse; air temperature is not water temperature; methods differ between series.

citations.reason: Reported that European freshwater invertebrate recovery came to a halt in TREAM; we confirm the richness plateau after about 2012 but show a continued composition shift to pollution-sensitive families.
